description: This file is a source file for a Next.js based React component module implementing message export functionalities, including preview, download, copy, and sharing of chat messages in various formats such as text, image, JSON, with UI components and hooks.

classes.name: ExportMessageModal
classes.description: A modal component for exporting messages, wrapping the MessageExporter.

classes.name: MessageExporter
classes.description: Main component handling selection, configuration, and preview of chat message exports in various formats.

classes.name: RenderExport
classes.description: Component that renders messages into the DOM and extracts them for external processing.

classes.name: PreviewActions
classes.description: UI component providing copy, download, and share actions for exported messages.

classes.name: ImagePreviewer
classes.description: Component for previewing chat messages as images, with copy and download functionalities.

classes.name: MarkdownPreviewer
classes.description: Component for rendering chat messages as Markdown, with export options.

classes.name: JsonPreviewer
classes.description: Component for exporting chat messages as JSON, with copy and download.

methods.name: useSteps
methods.description: Hook managing step navigation in the export process.
